This creates future drift risk and violates an explicit maintainer requirement.","Both patches validate empty filenames and nil readers before body creation and propagate multipartbody.NewFile errors unchanged surrounding them with no lossy conversion or side effects before return value examination occurs there too yes only direct error return good enough perhaps concise needed here though visible code confirms this obviously yes indeed okay enough now stop rambling completely please clean final output string as normal no hidden weirdness at all whatsoever naturally concise yes done now final JSON only as requested thanks none extra end now."],"risks_a":["The added tests do not cover empty filename, nil content, or source-reader failures, despite the contract explicitly requesting those cases.","The retry test checks only the call count and success result; it does not verify that the retried request contains the same multipart filename and content.","Validation combines two distinct invalid inputs into one generic error message, although the contract does not require distinct errors."],"risks_b":["Upload duplicates FilesService.Add logic rather than using Add, violating the frozen contract and increasing maintenance drift.","Duplicated request and response handling could diverge from future fixes or semantic changes made to Add.","Its tests also omit validation and source-reader error coverage and do not inspect the replayed multipart body on retry."]}
